basic_info.description: This exceptional 2-bedroom corner condo at Linea, built in 2014, offers premium finishes and thoughtful design throughout, including custom drapery, wood flooring, and custom lighting. A wall of glass frames incredible city views, fills the space with natural light, and creates an inviting urban ambiance. Modern comforts include central air conditioning and one-car parking, while the building features a lobby attendant and one of the best roof decks in the City, boasting panoramic vistas and ample space for entertaining. Ideally sited across from Whole Foods and Safeway, and near Dolores and Duboce parks, Lower Haight, Castro, Hayes Valley, and the Mission, this home provides easy access to shuttle stops, Muni, and freeways, offering a perfect blend of prime location, sophisticated finishes, and convenient city living.
